description: This is a Java source file defining an Android ListActivity called List9. It displays a list of cheeses and shows a letter overlay indicating the first letter of the visible items during scrolling. It manages a custom overlay window that appears when scrolling and disappears after a delay.

classes.name: List9
classes.description: An Android ListActivity that displays a list of cheeses and overlays the first letter of the current visible range using a floating TextView.

classes.name: RemoveWindow
classes.description: A private inner class implementing Runnable to handle removal of the overlay window after a delay.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the list adapter, inflates the overlay view, and adds it to the window manager.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Marks the activity as ready for interaction after resuming.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Removes the overlay window and marks the activity as not ready when paused.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Removes the overlay view from window manager and performs cleanup when activity is destroyed.

methods.name: onScroll
methods.description: Handles scroll events, showing the overlay with the first letter of the current visible item and scheduling its removal.

methods.name: onScrollStateChanged
methods.description: No implementation, present to fulfill interface requirement.

methods.name: removeWindow
methods.description: Hides the overlay TextView by setting visibility to INVISIBLE.
